verses.1: And Joshua, the old man, came in those days. And Jehovah said to him, “You are old now. You have come in those days, but the land remains largely unoccupied for its inheritance.”
verses.2: This is the land that remains for all those who are descendants of the Philistines, and for all those who are descendants of their wives.
verses.3: From the borders of Egypt, all the way to the borders of Ekron in Canaan, there are five cities belonging to the Philistines: Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, Ekron, and Azekah.
verses.4: From the borders of all the Canaanite lands, and from the cities that belonged to the Amorites, all the way up to the borders of Egypt.
verses.5: And the land of Givlim, and all the Lebanon, from the sunrise in the east, from Mount Gad below Mount Hermon, until the coming of dawn.
verses.6: All those who live on the mountain, from the rocks to the shores of the sea. All those who hunt in those areas – I will remove them from before the children of Israel. Only those who belong to Israel shall be allowed to remain there, according to what you have commanded.
verses.7: And now, divide this land into seven portions for the seven tribes, and half of those portions for the non-Jewish tribes.
verses.8: With him were his sons and his relatives. They received their inheritance, which Moses had given them across the Jordan from the east side. This was the same inheritance that Moses gave to the servants of Jehovah.
verses.9: From the area located on the banks of the Arnon River, and from the city that lies within the river’s territory, and all the villages from Idba to Dibon.
verses.10: And all the cities of Sihon, the king of the Amorites, who ruled until the borders of the children of Ammon.
verses.11: And Gilad, and the borders of Geshuri, and Ma’akhati, and all of the mountain of Harmon, and all of Bashan, right up to Salcha.
verses.12: All kingdoms are destroyed by those who rule in a cruel and unjust manner. They remain as the ones who heal others. Moses took them over and inherited them.
verses.13: And the children of Israel did not destroy the Gibealites and the Meara’im. Instead, the Gibealites and Meara’im continued to live among the Israelites until today.
verses.14: But to the tribe of Levi, Jehovah God of Israel did not give any inheritance. That is their inheritance, as it is written in the Torah.
verses.15: And Moses gave the land to the sons of Reuben for their inheritance.
verses.16: And they had a boundary line that ran from the village located on the banks of the Arnon River. The city itself was located within that river’s territory. And all the settlements along that boundary line also belonged to them.
verses.17: Its cities and all its towns are located in the territory of Dibon. There are also houses and homes there.
verses.18: And he will be exalted and precede others.
verses.19: And Kiryatayim, Shechem, and Zedad of the Chaldeans on Mount Hermon.
verses.20: And the house of Peor, and the house of Ashdod in Pisgah, and the house of Yishmo’t.
verses.21: And all the cities of Sihon, and all the kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon. Moses defeated him, along with the rulers of Midian: Avi, Rekem, Zor, Hur, and Reba, the kings of Sihon’s land.
verses.22: And Bilam, son of Beor the Kossam, was killed by the Israelites in the battle against them.
verses.23: And there was a border for the descendants of Reuben in the land of Canaan. This border became the territory of the descendants of Reuben, along with their cities and villages.
verses.24: And Moses gave Matti Gad to the children of Gad, as a gift for their families.
verses.25: And they had a border around them. All the cities of Gilad, and half of the land of Beni’am, were within their borders, all the way up to the city that was located on the slopes of Rabbah.
verses.26: And from what can be seen from afar, and in the mountains and from the camps, all the way to the borders of Lidvur.
verses.27: And in the wilderness of Bet Horam, and in the cities of Nimrah, Suhah, Zaphon, and other places, there was a kingdom ruled by Sihon, king of Heshbon. This kingdom extended all the way to the coast of the Sea of Kinneret, beyond the Jordan River.
verses.28: This is the inheritance of the descendants of Gad, for their cities and their palaces.
verses.29: And Moses gave half of the land to Manasseh. Thus, Manasseh’s sons received half of the land as their inheritance.
verses.30: And their borders extended from their camps all the way to the kingdom of the Babylonians. All the cities in that kingdom were illuminated by light from the Babylonians’ lamps.
verses.31: And half of the tribes and their cities were given to the sons of Machir, son of Manasseh. These cities became part of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.32: These are the people who were led by Moses in the evenings of Moab, from beyond the Jordan to Jericho, from Zerahah.
verses.33: And the throne of David did not give Moses any inheritance from Jehovah, the God of Israel. This is what He said to them regarding their inheritance.
